metadata.author: Yoto
metadata.description:
Open your heart and step into the sunshine with Fuzz, the brightest sun in the sky with the biggest heart you can ever imagine!  

This card is packed with sweet affirmations and heart-warming facts that will get you glowing.  

Whenever you need a boost or a friendly smile, just press the button on your Yoto player and Fuzz will cook up something delightful! There are over 100 responses that feel like a high five, compliment and hug all rolled into one!    

Could you be the reason someone is feeling happy today?  

Or maybe you’re about to discover just how special you truly are?  

Open your ears and let the rays of sunshine brighten your day!

PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto player or Yoto Mini to experience the interactive randomisation of the responses as designed.
